commands.name: save-clipboard

commands.subtitle: Pond

commands.name: save-current-tab

tools.name: search-library
tools.title: Search Library
tools.description: Search saves by keywords, source, exact tag, and saved date. Returns metadata, original URLs, Pond links, library IDs, and a pagination cursor.

tools.name: save-url
tools.title: Save URL
tools.description: Queue a web URL for archiving in the active Pond library, with optional tags. For existing URLs, supplied tags are added to their current tags.

tools.name: get-save
tools.title: Get Save
tools.description: Read a save and its metadata using the exact save ID and library ID from search results.

tools.name: get-library-info
tools.title: Get Library Info
tools.description: Read the active Pond library name, path, and number of saves.

tools.name: list-libraries
tools.title: List Libraries
tools.description: List recent Pond libraries with their exact paths, active status, and availability.

tools.name: switch-library
tools.title: Switch Library
tools.description: Switch to an available recent library using its exact path from List Libraries. Subsequent searches and saves use this library.

tools.name: open-save
tools.title: Open Save
tools.description: Open an existing save in Pond using its save ID and library ID from search results.

tools.name: open-library
tools.title: Open Library
tools.description: Bring Pond to the front and open its active library. Works without an API token.

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: Local API Token
preferences.description: Copy the token from Pond Settings → General → Raycast. Required for search and save commands.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Local API URL
preferences.description: Pond's local HTTP API address. Only localhost, 127.0.0.1, or [::1] is supported.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
